body.hash_rule: lowercase SHA-256 of RFC 8785/JCS bytes with canonical_hash and signature omitted
body.signature_rule: Ed25519 signature over the ASCII lowercase 64-hex canonical hash suffix
checks: resolve exactly one trusted provider-fact key active at observed_at
bind exact project, root, authority, child, request and provider wire body
bind connector identity, type, environment, amount, currency and response digest
require amount and currency to fit the signed provider_verified authority and root pool
non_claims: does not establish provider acceptance or completion
